description: This file contains JUnit test cases for the OrderTypeValidator class in the OpenMRS API project. It tests validation logic for OrderType objects, including null fields, duplicates, parent-child relationships, field length constraints, and validation invocation during save operations.

classes.name: OrderTypeValidatorTest
classes.description: JUnit test class for validating the behavior of OrderTypeValidator within the OpenMRS platform.

methods.name: validate_shouldFailIfTheOrderTypeObjectIsNull
methods.description: Tests that validation throws an IllegalArgumentException when the OrderType object is null.

methods.name: validate_shouldFailIfNameIsNull
methods.description: Tests validation errors when the OrderType's name is null.

methods.name: validate_shouldFailIfNameIsEmpty
methods.description: Tests validation errors when the OrderType's name is an empty string.

methods.name: validate_shouldFailIfNameIsWhitespace
methods.description: Tests validation errors when the OrderType's name is whitespace.

methods.name: validate_shouldFailIfNameIsWhiteSpace
methods.description: Duplicate of previous; tests validation errors when the OrderType's name consists of whitespace.

methods.name: validate_shouldFailIfNameIsADuplicate
methods.description: Ensures validation detects duplicate OrderType names.

methods.name: validate_shouldFailIfConceptClassIsADuplicate
methods.description: Checks whether duplicate concept classes added to OrderType are caught as validation errors.

methods.name: validate_shouldFailIfParentIsAmongItsDescendants
methods.description: Validates that an OrderType cannot be its own descendant or have a cyclic parent relationship.

methods.name: validate_shouldFailIfParentIsAlsoADirectChild
methods.description: Ensures that an OrderType cannot set its descendant as its parent directly.

methods.name: validate_shouldPassIfAllFieldsAreCorrectForANewOrderType
methods.description: Verifies validation passes for a correctly populated OrderType.

methods.name: validate_shouldPassIfAllFieldsAreCorrectForAnExistingOrderType
methods.description: Verifies that existing valid OrderType objects pass validation.

methods.name: validate_shouldBeInvokedWhenAnOrderTypeIsSaved
methods.description: Checks that saving an invalid OrderType triggers validation and throws an APIException.

methods.name: validate_shouldPassValidationIfFieldLengthsAreCorrect
methods.description: Tests validation passes when field length constraints are not exceeded.

methods.name: validate_shouldFailValidationIfFieldLengthsAreNotCorrect
methods.description: Tests validation errors are raised when field lengths exceed limits.
